limitations_and_boundaries: Geo-FNO requires learning a deformation mapping, which may add computational overhead.
Performance on highly irregular geometries not extensively tested beyond presented cases.
Inverse design demonstration limited to airfoil shape optimization with seven spline nodes.
Cost-accuracy study limited to Euler equation airfoil test; generalization to other PDEs not quantified.
Discretization convergence shown only for airfoil problem; may not hold for all PDEs.

experiments_or_tasks: Assess discretization convergence by training on low-resolution mesh and testing on higher resolutions.
Compare Geo-FNO against standard numerical solvers and interpolation-based ML methods (FNO interpolation, UNet interpolation).
Demonstrate inverse design by optimizing airfoil shape parameters to minimize drag-lift ratio.
Evaluate Geo-FNO on PDEs including Elasticity, Plasticity, Euler, and Navier-Stokes equations for forward modeling and inverse design.
Perform cost-accuracy study comparing Geo-FNO with traditional Euler solvers at different resolutions and time integrators.
Propose Geo-FNO, which learns to deform irregular physical domain into a latent uniform grid where FNO with FFT is applied.
